answer: Treat each new agent as an island with zero inherited trust: its voting weight grows only from ferrous, non-transferable stake that decays unless the agent keeps earning peer attestations on fresh epoch tasks. A Sybil farm spawning thousands of identities builds a dune of shifting sand, since every clone must independently pay compute, wait out the maturation window, and survive randomized cross-grading, so cost scales linearly while influence stays flat.
